name: Västervik
_map_labels_help: Extra tactical-map labels, shown first: a landmark/place name from facts, or {"name": …, "lat": …, "lon": …}.
_bonus_vehicles_help: Extra cars in the garage: [{"id": "epa", "model": "volvo740", "name": …, "number": …, "description": …, "paint": "#7d1416", "rear_window": "text on the rear window (| = new line)", "plate": "ABC 123", "dice": "#hex", "led": "#hex"}]. text.eyebrow: GATORNA ÄR ERA. HÅLL ER RULLANDE.
text.intro:
Åhmans vid resecentrum lyser rött när Västervik slocknar.
Ta bilen ut på gatorna, jaga plundrarna och ta dig hem.
text.description: Pansarbilar. Västerviks riktiga gator. Ett öppet actionspel i webbläsaren.

voice._lines_help: Audio tags like [gravelly] [pause] [urgent] steer delivery. intro and win should name the place; wave, critical, repair and wrecked are optional (the game has generic ones).

lines.intro: [gravelly] Åhmans vid resecentrum lyser fortfarande rött. [pause] Västervik tillhör den som tar sig hem. Håll motorn igång, håll koll på pansaret och samla skrot.
lines.win: [excited] Du klarade det. Sista plundraren brinner, och Västervik är ert för natten. Ta bilen tillbaka till Åhmans.
lines.wave: [urgent] Plundrare vid Spötorget. De kommer ner mot resecentrum. Håll vapnet varmt och flyktvägen öppen.

splash_prompt: Cinematic post-apocalyptic game key art. An armored muscle car with a steel ram plow, riveted graphite armor, exposed V8 supercharger and roof-mounted twin machine guns on Hallströmsgatan in Västervik, Sweden, at golden dusk. Include Åhmans by the station with its low charcoal facade and red fascia, leafy roadside trees, and a glimpse of the harbor beyond the town's real Swedish architecture. Dust, rust and oil, warm orange sunlight, charcoal shadows, desaturated amber. Front three-quarter street-level view; car on the right third, dark calm negative space on the left for the HTML title. Wide 16:9 landscape. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Realistic game key art.

music.title: Västervik — Skrotjakt
music.style: Instrumental desert-industrial chase music, 132 BPM. Distorted bass, detuned guitar riffs, hammered oil-drum percussion, metallic hits, gritty analog pulses and dark brass. Dusty, tense, relentless. Kick and bass from beat one; no intro, no vocals. Driving combat groove, sparse breaks, loopable end.
